visa_requirement_type: Visa C required; conditional exemptions; eVisa route
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period; Visa C validity may be up to five years as granted.
entry_count: Single, double or multiple entry as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least three months beyond requested visa expiry.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two blank pages; provide copies of relevant passport pages.
proof_of_funds_rule: Evidence of sufficient funds; official border guidance indicates ALL5,000 per day for adults and ALL2,500 per day for minors.
accommodation_rule: Proof of accommodation; host invitation/guarantee if staying with a host.
travel_insurance_rule: Follow the visa-specific eVisa checklist; no minimum insurance amount is stated in the reviewed current MFA border guidance.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: International vaccination certificate may be requested when arriving from a country affected by an epidemic/disease for which Albania requires vaccination; no Bangladesh-specific yellow-fever rule stated.
transit_rule: Airport-transit Visa A is a separate category; the Bangladesh fee schedule lists a Visa A fee. Confirm whether the exact airside itinerary requires it before travel.
application_channel: Apply online through the official eVisa portal. For paper/consular applications, the Bangladesh fee schedule lists Beijing as the competent mission.
application_fee: Visa C: EUR40 single / EUR80 double or multiple; airport-transit A: EUR25 single; long-stay D: EUR80.
processing_time: 15 working days; may extend to 30 in exceptional cases.
required_documents: Online visa application form|passport copy|recent 47x36 mm photo|return ticket or travel reservation|proof of accommodation or host invitation|proof of sufficient funds|supporting documents for tourism purpose|translations into Albanian or English where required|any additional documents requested by the eVisa portal

cross_check_source_name: Albanian Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs — visa regime for foreign citizens
review_notes: Bangladesh ordinary passports are explicitly listed as visa-required in the official visa-regime table. The current MFA page sets conditional exemptions for holders of qualifying used multiple-entry Schengen/EU/US/UK visas or qualifying residence permits, including the stated UAE 10-year permit condition. The 2026 fee schedule lists Bangladesh-specific fees and Beijing as the paper-application mission. The eVisa portal accepts online applications; the exact checklist is visa-category dependent.
notes: Verified for Bangladesh ordinary passport tourism on 2026-11-14. Base route is Visa C/eVisa; conditional exemptions are not unconditional visa-free access.

maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days under a short-stay C visitor visa; final permission and stay are determined at the border.
entry_count: Single or multiple entry as granted; multiple-entry visas are limited to qualifying circumstances.
passport_validity_rule: Passport must be valid for at least six months after the planned date of leaving Ireland.
blank_passport_pages_rule: A blank passport page is needed for the visa sticker; the current tourist checklist does not state a minimum blank-page count.
return_ticket_rule: Provide a travel itinerary and evidence of planned departure/return; do not purchase non-refundable tickets before the visa decision.
proof_of_funds_rule: Provide six months of bank statements and evidence that the applicant or sponsor can fund the trip; no fixed minimum amount is published in the tourist checklist.
accommodation_rule: Provide hotel/accommodation plan or host invitation with the host's address and supporting details.
travel_insurance_rule: The reviewed short-stay tourist checklist does not state a fixed travel-insurance minimum; carry suitable cover and provide additional evidence if requested.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No Bangladesh-specific yellow-fever or other health requirement is stated in the reviewed Irish tourist-visa guidance.
transit_rule: Bangladesh is not listed on the current Irish transit-visa-required nationality list. Direct airside transit does not require a transit visa, but leaving the transit area, an overnight stay, terminal change or baggage re-check may require entry permission; Bangladeshi nationals need an entry visa to enter Ireland.
application_channel: Complete AVATS online, print and sign the application summary, then submit the passport and supporting documents to the visa office named on the summary. A physical visa sticker is issued; no eVisa.
application_fee: EUR60 single-entry / EUR100 multiple-entry. The EUR25 transit fee applies only to transit-visa-required nationalities; Bangladesh is not on the current transit list.
processing_time: Generally about eight weeks after the complete application documents are received; timing varies by office and season.
required_documents: Completed AVATS application summary printed and signed|application letter explaining purpose and itinerary|current passport valid six months after departure|copies of all previous passports|two colour passport photographs|travel itinerary and airline booking/reservation|hotel reservation or host invitation and accommodation details|six months of bank statements and proof of funds|evidence of legal residence if applying outside the country of nationality|previous visa refusal letters|certified translations of documents not in English or Irish
official_immigration_source_name: Department of Foreign Affairs — list of visa-required and non-visa-required nationalities
cross_check_source_name: Irish Immigration Service — how to apply for a short-stay C visit/tourist visa
review_notes: The official DFA nationality list includes Bangladesh as visa-required; the published list was last updated 20 October 2023, so the source date is retained as a caveat. Current Irish Immigration guidance confirms that visa need is nationality-based and sets the short-stay C tourist application route, fees and approximate processing time. Bangladesh is not on the current transit-visa-required list, but leaving airside requires entry permission.
notes: Verified for Bangladesh ordinary passport tourism on 2026-11-14. No visa on arrival or eVisa; apply through AVATS and submit physical passport.

visa_requirement_type: Short-stay C/T tourist visa required; eVisa available with invitation rule
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period under a short-stay C visa; exact stay is as granted.
entry_count: Single or multiple entry as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Issued within the previous 10 years and valid for at least three months beyond the intended date of leaving Moldova.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No minimum blank-page count is stated in the reviewed MFA tourist-visa checklist.
return_ticket_rule: Round-trip ticket reservation or equivalent onward-travel evidence.
proof_of_funds_rule: Recent bank statement; at least EUR30 per day and not less than EUR300 for a stay shorter than 10 days, unless an accepted maintenance/accommodation commitment applies.
accommodation_rule: Tourist accommodation reservation or a host's maintenance/accommodation commitment; invitation from the General Inspectorate for Migration is required for Bangladesh unless an official exception applies.
travel_insurance_rule: Travel medical insurance valid in Moldova with minimum cover EUR30,000.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No Bangladesh-specific yellow-fever rule is stated in the reviewed Moldovan visa guidance.
transit_rule: Bangladesh is listed as requiring visa for entry, exit and transit and as requiring an airport-transit Visa A. Visa A is EUR20 and transit Visa B is EUR40; statutory exemptions may apply to holders of qualifying EU/Schengen/UK/US/Canada visas or residence permits.
application_channel: Apply online for short-stay Visa C/T through the government eVisa portal or at a Moldovan diplomatic/consular mission. Bangladesh applicants must provide a General Inspectorate for Migration invitation unless they hold a qualifying valid EU/Schengen/UK/US/Canada visa or residence permit; that exception waives the invitation, not the Moldovan visa.
application_fee: Visa C/T EUR40; airport-transit A EUR20; transit B EUR40.
processing_time: Up to 10 calendar days; may be extended to 20 days.
required_documents: Visa application form|passport issued within 10 years and valid three months beyond departure|recent 35x45 mm colour photograph|General Inspectorate for Migration invitation unless a statutory invitation exception applies|tourist accommodation booking or host commitment|round-trip ticket reservation|recent bank statement showing EUR30 per day and at least EUR300 for stays under 10 days|travel medical insurance with at least EUR30,000 cover
official_immigration_source_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Moldova — visa regime for foreigners
cross_check_source_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Moldova — types of visas and requirements
review_notes: The MFA visa-regime page lists Bangladesh in the entry/exit/transit visa-required list, the airport-transit-visa list and the invitation-required list. The [2] conditional visa exemption does not apply to Bangladesh. The invitation exception for holders of valid EU/Schengen/UK/US/Canada visas or residence permits waives the invitation only; it does not waive the Moldovan visa. Official eVisa guidance confirms tourism is eligible for type C eVisa, fee EUR40 and up to 10 calendar days (extendable to 20).
notes: Verified for Bangladesh ordinary passport tourism on 2026-11-14. The invitation waiver is not a visa exemption.

visa_requirement_type: Short-stay Visa C required; conditional exemptions apply
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period under Visa C; multiple-entry visa validity may be six months to five years where justified.
entry_count: Single, double or multiple entry as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Passport must be valid at least three months beyond the intended visa validity.
blank_passport_pages_rule: The current Bangladesh VFS checklist does not state a minimum blank-page count; confirm with VFS before submission.
return_ticket_rule: Provide return/onward ticket or other evidence of means and intention to return.
proof_of_funds_rule: At least EUR50 per day for the planned stay, or accepted sponsor/host evidence.
travel_insurance_rule: Proof of health/travel insurance is required.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No Bangladesh-specific yellow-fever requirement is stated in the reviewed Montenegro visa guidance.
transit_rule: Visa B is the transit category and permits transit up to five days. Airside transit that remains within the international transit area is generally distinct from entry; confirm terminal/baggage arrangements with the airline. Conditional visa exemptions may also apply.
application_channel: Apply in person through the VFS Global Montenegro Visa Application Centre in Dhaka. The current VFS notice states applications are forwarded to the Embassy of Montenegro in Abu Dhabi from 1 June 2026.
application_fee: Visa C/B EUR35; children under 14 EUR17.50. VFS service charge BDT4,300 and mandatory two-way courier BDT7,735 are separate provider charges and may change.
processing_time: Bangladesh VFS guidance: minimum three to four weeks; indicative only and subject to the Embassy's decision.
required_documents: Visa application form and appointment|valid passport|recent 35x45 mm colour photograph|proof of travel purpose|accommodation booking or host invitation|return/onward ticket or other proof of return|proof of funds at EUR50 per day|travel health insurance|visa fee payment|any additional documents requested by the Embassy or VFS

visa_requirement_type: Short-stay Visa C required; conditional exemptions apply
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period for Visa C; qualifying third-country visas/residence permits may allow entry up to 90 days in a six-month period within their validity.
entry_count: Single, double or multiple entry as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least 90 days after the intended departure from Serbia.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two consecutive blank pages.
return_ticket_rule: Provide return/onward travel evidence and, for transit, evidence of permission to enter the onward destination where applicable.
proof_of_funds_rule: Sufficient funds for the stay and return; the reviewed MFA page does not publish a fixed daily amount.
accommodation_rule: Hotel booking or host invitation/proof of accommodation.
travel_insurance_rule: Travel medical insurance covering the stay is required.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No Bangladesh-specific yellow-fever or other health requirement is stated in the reviewed Serbian visa guidance.
transit_rule: A transit Visa C is required unless the traveller qualifies for conditional visa-free entry using a valid Schengen/UK/EU/US visa or qualifying residence permit; carry onward-ticket and destination-entry evidence.
application_channel: Apply at a Serbian diplomatic/consular mission or submit online through the official Welcome to Serbia/e-Consulate portal. Bangladesh is covered on a non-resident basis by the Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi. The electronic Digital Travel Authorization is issued only for nationalities enabled on the portal; Bangladesh-specific DTA eligibility was not confirmed, so plan for a Visa C sticker unless the portal confirms otherwise.
application_fee: Visa C EUR92 at the Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi; EUR47 for applicants up to 12 years old.
processing_time: No standard processing SLA is published on the reviewed MFA pages; confirm the current estimate with the Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi.
required_documents: Visa application form|passport issued within 10 years and valid at least 90 days after departure|two consecutive blank pages|recent photograph|travel medical insurance|proof of tourist purpose and itinerary|hotel booking or host invitation|proof of sufficient funds|return/onward travel evidence|visa fee payment
